what_this_is: Answer to Joseph's question: is the stage-6 marginal-vs-independent-4D disagreement mathematics or a defect? ANSWER: NEITHER AS POSED. The cross-check is IDENTICALLY the per-column unfolded-content ratio minus one, so it does not measure whether unfolding and marginalization commute. All three commutation mechanisms are refuted by one measurement. The physics and the projector are sound; the REPORTING is not.

inputs.note_on_the_two_products: SAME data, SAME estimator family (lgbm), SAME 5 iterations, different dimensionality. So a regularization mismatch is present BY CONSTRUCTION -- identical iteration count at 10694 reported bins vs 4825.

RESULT_1_THE_IDENTITY_which_settles_the_.claim: the cross-section cross-check IS the per-column unfolded-content ratio minus one
RESULT_1_THE_IDENTITY_which_settles_the_.frac_seen_definition: frac_seen[r] = sum(reported 5D hUnfoldND over the W bins of column r) / (4D hUnfoldND in r)
RESULT_1_THE_IDENTITY_which_settles_the_.reading: the cross-section conversion CANCELS EXACTLY. The comparison carries no information beyond the content ratio, so it is not a measurement of commutation. The correlation of 1.000 was checked ALGEBRAICALLY rather than relied on -- a correlation of 1 can still hide an offset, and this one does not.

RESULT_2_ALL_THREE_COMMUTATION_MECHANISM.the_partition: number of reported W bins feeding each 4D column
RESULT_2_ALL_THREE_COMMUTATION_MECHANISM.THE_ARGUMENT: at nW=1 the row of M has ONE entry, so the 'marginalization' is multiplication by a single width and NO marginalization occurs. Those bins have the LARGEST disagreement (5.72%). Bins where all six W bins are reported have the SMALLEST (2.64%). A commutation effect -- nonlinearity, prior-weighted response collapse, or regularization mismatch -- must VANISH where there is nothing to marginalize. This one is MAXIMAL there.
RESULT_2_ALL_THREE_COMMUTATION_MECHANISM.why_this_is_not_a_magnitude_objection: it is the wrong SIGN OF DEPENDENCE, which no choice of coupling strength can fix. One table refutes mechanisms 1, 2 and 3 jointly.
RESULT_2_ALL_THREE_COMMUTATION_MECHANISM.AND_A_SECOND_VIEW_THAT_IS_NOT_CORROBORAT: an earlier pass reported '|rel| grows with W-shape concentration' as separate evidence. It is NOT: the dominant-W-fraction quartile 4 is the interval [1.00,1.00] with n=1309, i.e. EXACTLY the nW=1 bins. Two views of one measurement is not corroboration (BEN-300's general form), so it is withdrawn as independent evidence and recorded here only as the same fact.

W_coverage_of_the_5D_reported_support_pe.plain: a typical column reports 2 of its 6 W bins

RESULT_3_WHAT_IT_ACTUALLY_IS_a_support_m.reading: where the two products cover the same content they agree to 0.45% median and NEVER exceed 1.0%. The 4.4% is not created by projection or marginalization -- it is inherited one-for-one from the two reported supports being different subsets of the same spectrum.

RESULT_4_THE_PROJECTOR_IS_EXONERATED_ind.method: compare M @ x5[m5] against the 5D PRODUCER'S OWN W-marginal, hXSecND_dropLast_flat, which no code from the projecting lane touches

RESULT_5_MY_OWN_MECHANISM_2_PROBE_WAS_VA.the_probe: re-collapse the 5D completeness with the UNFOLDED W-shape and compare to the 4D completeness, on the reasoning that the 4D completeness is the prior-weighted collapse -- so the difference would estimate prior-weighted response collapse
RESULT_5_MY_OWN_MECHANISM_2_PROBE_WAS_VA.first_result: |dc|/c median, p90 and max ALL printed 0.0000 across 4825 bins
RESULT_5_MY_OWN_MECHANISM_2_PROBE_WAS_VA.why_that_was_a_warning_and_not_a_result: exactly zero on every bin is the signature of an IDENTITY, not an agreement -- and the reported correlation was non-nan, so the values were not literally zero either. A BEN-316 shape in this lane's own instrument.
RESULT_5_MY_OWN_MECHANISM_2_PROBE_WAS_VA.RULE: a quantity that does not move when you change its own weights is not measuring the weighting. The probe measured nothing about the prior.
RESULT_5_MY_OWN_MECHANISM_2_PROBE_WAS_VA.AND_THE_FAILED_PROBE_HAS_REAL_CONTENT_wh: invariance under UNIFORM weights means the 5D completeness has NO W-DEPENDENCE within a column. So mechanism 2 acting through efficiency/completeness is not merely small -- it is STRUCTURALLY ABSENT, because there is no W-variation for a prior to mis-weight. That distinction is the difference between 'we measured it and it was tiny' and 'it cannot arise by this route'.

RESULT_6_THE_NOISE_STORY_IS_EXCLUDED_BY_.reading_1: flat, not monotonic -- the disagreement does not concentrate at low cross-section
RESULT_6_THE_NOISE_STORY_IS_EXCLUDED_BY_.reading_2: the |rel|>10% bins are 3.6x BRIGHTER than typical. Only the five bins above 50% are faint. 'Concentrated in low-occupancy bins' is plausible and FALSE.

ANSWERS_TO_THE_FOUR_QUESTIONS_AS_ASKED.1_which_mechanisms_with_magnitudes: None of the three, at any magnitude. The driver is the support/content difference and it accounts for the disagreement EXACTLY (1.19e-14).
ANSWERS_TO_THE_FOUR_QUESTIONS_AS_ASKED.2_is_4.4pct_the_right_size: The question dissolves. The mechanisms need not explain 4.4% because 4.4% is not theirs. The support mismatch does not merely have the right SIZE -- it has the right VALUE, bin by bin.
ANSWERS_TO_THE_FOUR_QUESTIONS_AS_ASKED.3_where_do_the_large_delta_bins_live: NOT in low-occupancy bins (RESULT_6). They live where frac_seen departs from 1.
ANSWERS_TO_THE_FOUR_QUESTIONS_AS_ASKED.4_does_this_bear_on_the_deliverable: The marginal-is-the-deliverable convention is INTACT and STRENGTHENED. Bin-by-bin equality was never a coherent requirement between two products on different supports, so retiring that gate on 2026-08-09 was right. ONE REFINEMENT to the docstring's wording: the number is not 'a property of the independent unfold' either -- it is a property of THE SUPPORT DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE TWO PRODUCTS, a third thing, and attributing it to the independent unfold overstates what it says.
